messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: These symptoms include increased appetite.
These symptoms include weight gain.
These symptoms include trouble sleeping.
These symptoms include trouble concentrating.
These symptoms include a slower heart rate.
These symptoms include having the urge to smoke.
These symptoms include feeling anxious, restless, depressed, angry, frustrated, or irritated.
These symptoms may occur with or without using medication such as bupropion.
Smoking cessation may also cause new or worsening mental health problems, such as depression.
Triplet: ["smoking cessation", "may cause", "new or worsening mental health problems"]

The relation 'may cause' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject activity or condition may lead to the health issue or complication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
B. 'has symptom': The medical condition specified by the subject may present with the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'causes': The subject drug leads to or results in the effect or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
